scope: English-language European innovation and environmental funding for startups and SMEs. Programme-specific reviewed country coverage; not a worldwide or exhaustive eligibility database.

programmes.title: EIC Accelerator
programmes.country_note: Reviewed country coverage: EU Member States and the United Kingdom only. Other Horizon Europe associated countries may qualify but are not yet mapped in this pilot; check the official rules. Country coverage alone does not prove eligibility.
programmes.description: Support for ambitious, high-risk innovations ready for development and scale-up; not ordinary business software adoption.
checks: Check breakthrough innovation, market potential and technology readiness (TRL 6–8).
UK applicants can request grant-only support. Grant and investment components have different limits; no blended-finance cap is automatically checked.
Short proposals and full proposals follow different submission stages; confirm the relevant batch date.

programmes.title: EIC Pathfinder Open — 2026
programmes.country_note: Reviewed country coverage: EU Member States and the United Kingdom only. Other Horizon Europe associated countries may qualify but are not yet mapped in this pilot; check the official rules. Country coverage alone does not prove eligibility.
programmes.description: Early scientific research towards radically new technologies, through an international consortium.
checks: Verify a high-risk science-to-technology breakthrough, not routine product improvement.
Normally requires at least three independent entities in different eligible countries, including one EU Member State.
Indicative grant amounts may be exceeded with justification, so they are not treated as hard caps.

programmes.title: EIC Pathfinder Challenges — 2026
programmes.country_note: Reviewed country coverage: EU Member States and the United Kingdom only. Other Horizon Europe associated countries may qualify but are not yet mapped in this pilot; check the official rules. Country coverage alone does not prove eligibility.
programmes.description: Early-stage research in three defined challenges: miniaturised energy harvesting, healthy-ageing biotechnology and trustworthy cognitive AI.
checks: An R&D topic match is only a starting point: the project must fit one of the three specific challenge guides.
Check permitted single-applicant or consortium structure and low technology-readiness requirements.
Grant amounts depend on the call; no hard maximum is inferred from an indicative contribution.

programmes.title: EIC Transition — 2026
programmes.country_note: Reviewed country coverage: EU Member States and the United Kingdom only. Other Horizon Europe associated countries may qualify but are not yet mapped in this pilot; check the official rules. Country coverage alone does not prove eligibility.
programmes.description: Develop technology and a business case from results of a qualifying earlier EU-funded research project.
checks: An eligible predecessor project and rights to use its results are essential.
Check starting maturity (TRL 3 completed or TRL 4), market validation and applicant/consortium rules.
Recorded funding levels are indicative, not an automatic entitlement.

programmes.title: Eurostars — September 2026 call
programmes.country_note: The country list covers Eurostars participation. National agencies decide which applicants and costs receive funding; membership does not guarantee a grant.
programmes.description: International collaborative R&D led by an innovative SME, with funding administered through national agencies.
checks: At least two independent entities from two Eurostars countries; at least one country must be EU or Horizon-associated.
Check national funding availability, eligible costs, SME budget share and consortium budget balance.
Civil projects only; duration normally no more than 36 months.

programmes.title: Innowwide — 5th call, 2026
programmes.country_note: Coverage concerns the applicant SME, not its export destination or subcontractor. Those are separate eligibility checks.
programmes.description: A six-month feasibility study for an innovative solution in an overseas target market; not a general trade-fair subsidy.
checks: Target one market in Africa, the Americas, Asia or Oceania, with an independent local subcontractor.
The fifth call requires an SME established for at least two years and no earlier Innowwide award.
A fixed EUR 60,000 grant requires at least EUR 86,000 eligible costs; check the full workplan and cost rules. These extra conditions are not automated.

programmes.title: Eureka Network Projects
programmes.country_note: Pilot country coverage is limited to EU Member States. Other Eureka countries are not yet mapped. National funding availability is unverified, including for listed countries.
programmes.description: A route for international, civilian product or process R&D; national funding may be a grant or a loan.
checks: At least two independent entities from participating countries; no one organisation or country should carry more than 70% of the budget.
Confirm the national agency's active funding offer, partnership and call-specific conditions.
A Eureka label or permission to participate does not guarantee national funding.

programmes.title: LIFE Circular Economy and Zero Pollution — 2026 SAP
programmes.country_note: EU countries and associated countries on the reviewed LIFE list are covered. Territories, exceptional participation and later association changes require source review.
programmes.description: Environmental demonstration and best-practice projects, including resource recovery, waste and water management.
checks: Check the 2026 Standard Action Project topic, measurable environmental benefits and replication potential.
Ordinary equipment replacement alone does not establish fit; eligible costs and co-financing require review.

programmes.title: LIFE Climate Change Mitigation and Adaptation — 2026 SAPs
programmes.country_note: Reviewed LIFE country coverage applies; territories, exceptional routes and subsequent association changes are not fully mapped.
programmes.description: Pilot, demonstration and best-practice actions addressing emissions or resilience to climate change.
checks: Choose the relevant mitigation or adaptation topic and demonstrate climate impact.
Check eligible costs, co-financing, replication and project scale; not every solar or water-saving installation qualifies.

programmes.title: LIFE Clean Energy Transition — INDUSTRY 2026
programmes.country_note: Reviewed LIFE countries are covered. Other participation routes need manual verification; country coverage is not full eligibility.
programmes.description: Coordination and support for industrial clean-energy transition, rather than a simple machinery purchase grant.
checks: Check the INDUSTRY topic's cooperation model, applicant structure and required outputs.
Confirm market-barrier removal and energy-transition support activities; do not assume equipment costs are funded.
